backbone_reference_self_control.method: The frozen backbone fixture path (182-row prefill through the real SGLang-Omni OmniScheduler, unpatched) with max_running_requests=2; the 182-row target co-batched with a 2/7/128-row companion before or after it, or two copies in one 364-row call. Co-batching is supported by default upstream (up to 16 requests per batch, sglang-omni config.py:19); this run, like the frozen fixture, used eager execution with CUDA graphs disabled, whereas default serving also uses graphs. Chunked prefill is rejected by the reference for Drama 3 and was not run. Thresholds and metrics imported unchanged from backbone-reference-check.py.
backbone_reference_self_control.controls: solo-182 first and last reproduce the frozen reference hidden, semantic and full-logit bytes exactly; guard completion clean

reference_vs_itself.views_failing: 8/8 fail hidden_min_row_cosine (>= 0.995); 3/8 also all-row cosine (>= 0.999: companion-128-before, companion-128-after, pair-0); 3/8 also last-row cosine (>= 0.999); relative L2 and semantic gates pass in every view

backbone_reference_self_control.interpretation: The reference fails the minimum-row-cosine gate against its frozen solo output in every tested co-batched view; some views also fail the all-row or last-row cosine gates. This component is unattainable by the reference under these tested co-batching schedules; the experiment does not prove that every possible implementation must fail it. Native is still outside the reference self-variance envelope on relative L2 (0.124 vs at most 0.045) and semantic KL (0.024 vs at most 0.0049), so the backbone failure is not explained by schedule variance alone.

ba_projection_row_variance.verdict: Infeasible under the no-row-dispatch rule: the reference GDN in_proj_ba F.linear gives different bits for identical rows at different call shapes (cuBLAS gemvx at M=1, CUTLASS wmma at 2-15, nvjet split-K 16/8/4/3 variants above, position-dependent combine order in the 32x64 kernel). On 3,932,160 outputs per shape: M=1 vs 182 differ in 618, 2 vs 182 in 4,696, 1 vs 2 in 4,936. No single row-invariant arithmetic matches every reference shape; native canonical K16 already equals the reference at M=2 and 7.

backbone_worst_row_bar_revision.decision: The maintainer accepted that exact backbone parity is not required (infeasible under the no-row-dispatch rule) and asked for the 0.995 worst-row cosine bar to be revised from the reference's own self-variance, pre-registered before re-scoring native and not tuned to native.
backbone_worst_row_bar_revision.comparison: candidate >= bar, binary64, no rounding or margin
backbone_worst_row_bar_revision.proposer: an independent reviewer, blinded: native data not consulted
backbone_worst_row_bar_revision.reproduction: qualification/worst-row-bar.py; the CPU reproduction matched all eight view minima, rows and input hashes: bar 0.8712518909203973
backbone_worst_row_bar_revision.limitations: one 182-token fixture; eager execution without CUDA graphs; eight two-request co-batched views (three share identical hidden bytes); single run, no repeat-variance estimate; gate still evaluated against the solo frozen reference; a bar of this size permits a substantial isolated row discrepancy
backbone_worst_row_bar_revision.unchanged_bars: hidden all-row cosine >= 0.999, last-row cosine >= 0.999, relative L2 <= 0.05, semantic KL <= 0.01, top-30 >= 0.9, top-1 equal, semantic cosine/relL2, codec 40 dB / RMSE / max-abs / prefixes, tower gates: all unchanged

rescore.conclusion: Native fails the revised worst-row bar as well as five unchanged backbone gates; backbone sign-off is not reached. Codec frame 1 (33.1 dB vs 40) and the tower rows-7 top-1 gate also remain failing.

long_text_clipped_replies.behaviour: A reply reaching max_frames (1024) without end of speech returns its clipped audio with HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 500. Whole replies carry X-Finish-Reason: stop|length; streams declare Trailer: X-Finish-Reason and only a clipped stream ends with X-Finish-Reason: length.
long_text_clipped_replies.finding: All six reference 1024-frame replies in before/after 01 (medium-05 x2, long-02, long-04, long-07 x2) show the same signature as native long-05: speech stops early (reference 3-6 s, native about 11 s), then about -95 dBFS until the cap. The reference returns them as plain 200.
long_text_clipped_replies.not_fixed: long-05 still never emits end of speech under native seeded sampling; the text is not fully spoken in either engine for capped items. Cause not established.
